evidence.detail: Prevent flakiness in rotation page update by running cache clear in a subprocess — replaced threading with subprocess.Popen
More stable rotation page refresh — merged 2024-11-21
rotation_clear_cache() now calls subprocess.Popen(cmd) and immediately returns {'success': True} — the cache clear runs async in a child process, no longer blocking the HTTP request

triage.notes: Earlier commits also addressed this (6f3ed5d8 lighter rotation cache bust, d12224bf decksite DB caching layer). The subprocess approach in b823df16 is the definitive fix for the timeout.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in PR #13354 (commit b823df16): the clear_cache endpoint now fires the work off via `subprocess.Popen` and returns immediately, eliminating the Cloudflare gateway timeout.
